lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately 8 visible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows on the lateral flank, forming a regular grid of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibit a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance values along the top edge and lower-luminance shadow directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily located along the anterior and middle sections of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibits an irregular, non-uniform notch or indentation. A faint, elongated light-intensity mark is visible on the lower posterior flank near the ventral transition.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced-out blobs on the primary lateral flank.
